card.name: Words before 'project' in education text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation in school or course descriptions, right where a word like 'project' or 'practical activity' could come next. Seen in teaching guides and curriculum text.

modes.label: Verbs and links before an activity
modes.description: A verb or preposition that leads into a hands-on activity or course component.

modes.label: Punctuation or small words in teaching descriptions
modes.description: A comma, period, quote or preposition in a description of learning methods, where a project-type noun may follow.
